messages:
maria: Hey folks — trying to run the ruby sampleapp in Docker during onboarding and seeing auth retries against the registry. Image pull keeps 401ing, client retries and then our SDK logs an auth-refresh loop. Anyone seen this?

sam: Which registry? Docker Hub or our internal registry?

maria: internal. Using the onboarding compose that mounts credentials, but after the container starts the app does repeated refreshes and we hit rate limits.

jonathan: Are you setting DOCKER_CONFIG in the compose env? We saw a similar flub last month where the entrypoint overwrote it.

maria: Yes, we set DOCKER_CONFIG=/home/ci/.docker and mount the file to /home/ci/.docker/config.json. Error looks like:
```
E, [2026-03-15T12:04:02.123 #1] ERROR -- : failed to fetch token: 401 Unauthorized
E, [2026-03-15T12:04:02.223 #1] ERROR -- : SDK retry policy: backoff -> refresh -> 401 -> loop
```

tanya: Try checking perms + the entrypoint. If the entrypoint does `export DOCKER_CONFIG=/root/.docker` the app user won't see the mounted file.

jonathan: Exact culprit — our Dockerfile's entrypoint script does `export DOCKER_CONFIG=/root/.docker || true` before `exec gosu appuser "$@"`. That blew away the mounted path for the app process.

maria: Submitted a tiny PR to stop exporting if DOCKER_CONFIG exists: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ruby-sampleapp/pull/1278 — adds a guard and a unit test for startup env.

devex-bot: CI triggered for PR #1278 — running sampleapp-integration matrix

sam: Quick question — should the Ruby SDK suppress retries for registry 401s? Right now we conflate any 401 as model auth and attempt refresh.

jonathan: Good catch. I think SDK should only trigger token refresh for our API endpoints. For upstream deps (docker, registries) we should pass through 401s and allow the caller to handle.

tanya: Filed an SDK issue for ruby: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ruby-sdk/issues/456 — suggests adding response-source metadata to error so callers can ignore non-RI auth failures.

maria: Thanks all, PR linked and issue opened. Will follow up with a small sampleapp CI test that simulates missing DOCKER_CONFIG to avoid regressions.

sam: :thumbsup:
